arStrings.szText: Upheaval
Fury Skill: Tear into the ground with your weapon and fling debris towards your enemies.
{c_important}Upheaval{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_7}  * 100|%|]{/c} chance to Stun all enemies it damages for {c_number}[{SF_8}|1|]{/c} seconds.
Enhanced Upheaval

{c_important}Upheaval{/c} ignites the ground Burning enemies for an additional {c_number}{dot:BUFF_UPGRADE_A_FIRE_DOT}{/c} damage over {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_UPGRADE_A_FIRE_DOT}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Upheaval{/c} now deals Fire damage.
Trailblazing

{c_important}Upheaval{/c} flings {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} dealing {c_number}{payload:SHRAPNEL_DAMAGE}{/c} damage, and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_B_BLEED_DOT}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_B_BLEED_DOT}{/c} seconds.
Iron Burst
{c_important}Upheaval{/c} gains deals {c_number}[SF_36 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. Depending on the cast range, this area increases but the damage bonus decreases.
Suppress
{c_important}Upheaval{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the first {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} enemies hit.
Damage Increase
{c_important}Upheaval's{/c} Fury cost is reduced to {c_number}[{SF_39} - {SF_40}]{/c} Fury.
Fury Cost Reduction

{c_important}Upheaval{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} stack to increase {c_important}Upheavel's{/c} Size by {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|+%|]{/c} and damage by {c_number}[{SF_43}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Overpower
Every {c_number}{SF_46}{/c} Fury spent makes your next {c_important}Upheaval{/c} free to cast. This stacks up to {c_number}{SF_47}{/c} total Fury.
Free Cast
